name: load-under-churn
description: A busy Dolt project: bd list costs 13 units, bd export 50, a bead show 2.5, and an agent writes every 20-60 units (every other write closes a step). Two loaders (the API poll and the health loop) read the board through cmdrd's client stack. Each close must show on the board within a few list costs, no load may take longer than a few list costs, and no load may fall back to last-good rows. Before il9.202.25.1 a close took 34-55s at live costs (unit = 100ms) and loads took up to a minute.
